Delhi Ridge to be Rejuvenated with Saplings and Legal Protection

Union Home Minister Amit Shah announced a plan to plant one crore saplings and provide legal protection to the Delhi Ridge, aiming to rejuvenate 6,300 hectares over four years. This initiative is intended to develop the Ridge as Delhi's "lungs". However, the Congress party has raised questions regarding the order to transplant 1,049 trees and cut down 42 more.
